patterns.rationale: Voice session could not be started (needs microphone); the page is the pre-session briefing showing an animated sample transcript of the AI character's spoken turn. A live voice conversation with a model is implied but not observable.

structure.layout: single centered narrow column (472px) under a minimal top bar: back arrow left, Source + theme toggle right; scenario title, language-pair pill, mission description, hint pill, animated transcript stage between two rules, big primary CTA

aesthetics.typography: Libre Baskerville bold serif for the scenario title only; Nunito rounded sans for everything else (mission, transcript, buttons)
aesthetics.typeScale: Low contrast: 24px/700 serif title, 21px button label, 19-18px body/transcript, 14px pills and hints; weights 400-800

notes: Warm off-white paper background with olive green (#5c6b48) accent; GitHub Source link uses a dashed 2px olive border. Transcript text animates word-by-word with fade gradient top and bottom (karaoke caption of the AI barista's Spanish line plus an English aside). Two canvas elements (472x120) sit at the rules, likely audio visualizers. Theme toggle is an emoji 💻 in a white circle. Start Mission CTA is a large rounded-24px olive tile with italic subline.
